claim_text: Earlier in August 2026 South Korea, the United States and Japan detected the launch of a short-range ballistic missile from North Korea, the North's first ballistic weapons testing activity since late June, which landed in waters off its east coast.
quote: Earlier this month, South Korea, the U.S. and Japan detected the launch of a short-range ballistic missile from North Korea in what was the North's first ballistic weapons testing activity since late June.
confidence_justification: Detection reported by three allied governments and relayed by AP.
